rule: precomposed क़ (U+0958) decomposes under NFC, then loses its nukta
ड़ and ढ़ unchanged in a phrase
म् before ब and न् before ध

vowel signs kept (Whisper's normaliser would split this word)
zero-width space is a word break
punctuation only gives an empty string

apostrophe deleted, not turned into a space
nasal rule and danda in a sentence
